editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing the person you love most was just killed again, and the only way to fix it is to jump back ten years into your past. That is the wild ride you get with this story. You follow Takemichi, a guy who is not exactly a tough fighter but has a heart of gold and a lot of grit. He is fighting against the Tokyo Manjikai Gang, a group of scary delinquents who rule the streets. The vibe is a mix of high-school drama and gritty crime, making you feel the pressure as Takemichi tries to stop a tragedy before it happens. It is an emotional rollercoaster that keeps you guessing about who is actually a friend and who is a traitor.

The action scenes are punchy and keep the energy high, though the pacing slows down a bit during the talking parts. The acting is solid, especially the way they show the bond between the gang members. If you are into stories about time travel and street fights, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie ends on a huge cliffhanger. Takemichi manages to survive the brutal fight, but he realizes that changing the past is harder than it looks. He discovers that the founders of the gang had a tragic bond that makes them loyal to the core. He barely escapes with his life, but the cycle of violence continues. You are left wondering if he can actually save Hinata or if he is just delaying the inevitable death.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves anime adaptations and time travel mysteries.
